translations.en.sahih: By the sun and its brightness
translations.en.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
translations.id.indonesian: Demi matahari dan cahayanya di pagi hari,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the moon when it follows it
translations.en.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Moon as she follows him;

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the day when it displays it
translations.en.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers it
translations.en.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Night as it conceals it;

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
translations.en.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
translations.en.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
translations.en.yusufali: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;

translations.en.sahih: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
translations.en.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
translations.en.yusufali: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
translations.id.indonesian: maka Allah mengilhamkan kepada jiwa itu (jalan) kefasikan dan ketakwaannya.

translations.en.sahih: He has succeeded who purifies it,
translations.en.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang yang mensucikan jiwa itu,

translations.en.sahih: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
translations.en.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
translations.en.yusufali: And he fails that corrupts it!
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya merugilah orang yang mengotorinya.

translations.en.sahih: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
translations.en.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
translations.en.yusufali: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
translations.id.indonesian: (Kaum) Tsamud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas,

translations.en.sahih: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
translations.en.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
translations.id.indonesian: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka,

arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
transliteration: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa

translations.en.sahih: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
translations.en.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
translations.en.yusufali: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka: ("Biarkanlah) unta betina Allah dan minumannya".

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa

translations.en.sahih: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
translations.en.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
translations.en.yusufali: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelih unta itu, maka Tuhan mereka membinasakan mereka disebabkan dosa mereka, lalu Allah menyama-ratakan mereka (dengan tanah),

translations.en.sahih: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
translations.en.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
translations.en.yusufali: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Allah tidak takut terhadap akibat tindakan-Nya itu.
